claims.statement: A will-o'-the-wisp or ignis fatuus is an atmospheric ghost light seen by travellers at night, especially over bogs, swamps, or marshes.
claims.statement_id: Will-o'-the-wisp atau ignis fatuus adalah cahaya hantu atmosfer yang dilihat musafir di malam hari di atas rawa atau lahan basah.
claims.quote: In folklore, a will-o'-the-wisp, or will-o'-wisp (Latin: ignis fatuus, "foolish flame"), is an atmospheric ghost light seen by travellers at night, especially over bogs, swamps, or marshes.

claims.statement: Will-o'-the-wisps are typically attributed as ghosts, fairies or elemental spirits meant to reveal or conceal a path or direction.
claims.statement_id: Will-o'-the-wisp biasanya dianggap sebagai hantu, peri, atau roh alam penunjuk atau penyembunyi jalan.
claims.quote: In folklore, will-o'-the-wisps are typically attributed as ghosts, fairies or elemental spirits meant to reveal (or conceal) a path or direction.

claims.statement: These wisps are portrayed as dancing or flowing in a static form, until noticed or followed, in which case they visually fade or disappear.
claims.statement_id: Cahaya ini digambarkan menari atau melayang statis hingga memudar atau lenyap saat diikuti.
claims.quote: These wisps are portrayed as dancing or flowing in a static form, until noticed or followed, in which case they visually fade or disappear.

claims.statement: The term will-o'-the-wisp comes from wisp, a bundle of sticks or paper used as a torch, and the name Will.
claims.statement_id: Istilah will-o'-the-wisp berasal dari kata wisp yang berarti ikatan kayu atau kertas untuk obor, dan nama Will.
claims.quote: The term will-o'-the-wisp comes from wisp, a bundle of sticks or paper sometimes used as a torch and the name 'Will', thus meaning 'Will of the torch'.

claims.statement: The term jack-o'-lantern originally referred to a will-o'-the-wisp.
claims.statement_id: Istilah jack-o'-lantern awalnya merujuk pada will-o'-the-wisp.
claims.quote: The term jack-o'-lantern ('Jack of the lantern') originally referred to a will-o'-the-wisp.

claims.statement: Equivalents of will-o'-the-wisps appear in European folklore under names such as ignis fatuus, feu follet, Irrlicht, dwaallicht, and fuoco fatuo.
claims.statement_id: Padanan will-o'-the-wisp muncul dalam cerita rakyat Eropa dengan berbagai nama, seperti ignis fatuus, feu follet, Irrlicht, dwaallicht, dan fuoco fatuo.
claims.quote: Equivalents of the will-o'-the-wisps appear in European folklore by various names, e.g., ignis fatuus in Latin, feu follet in French, Irrlicht or Irrwisch in Germany, dwaallicht in The Netherlands and fuoco fatuo in Italy.

claims.statement: The phenomenon is known in the United Kingdom by various names including jack-o'-lantern, friar's lantern, and hinkypunk.
claims.statement_id: Di Britania Raya fenomena ini dikenal dengan berbagai nama termasuk jack-o'-lantern, friar's lantern, dan hinkypunk.
claims.quote: The phenomenon is known in the United Kingdom by a variety of names, including jack-o'-lantern, friar's lantern, and hinkypunk, and is said to mislead and/or guide travellers by resembling a flickering lamp or lantern.

claims.statement: In Scottish folklore, will-o'-the-wisps are depicted as mischievous spirits or ghosts of the dead eager to lead travellers off path and to death.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Skotlandia, will-o'-the-wisp digambarkan sebagai roh jahil atau hantu orang mati yang memikat pengelana keluar dari jalur menuju kematian.
claims.quote: In Scottish folklore, will-o’-the-wisps are variously depicted either as mischievous spirits (typically fairies), or even the ghosts of the dead, eager to lead travellers off their path and into their death.

claims.statement: The lights typically appear close to a bog, marsh, or swamp where straying off path can become dangerous or deadly.
claims.statement_id: Cahaya tersebut biasanya muncul dekat rawa atau paya di mana tersesat dari jalan setapak bisa berbahaya atau mematikan.
claims.quote: The lights typically appear close to a bog, marsh, or swamp, places where straying off the beaten path can become dangerous – or even deadly.

claims.statement: Few myths show the will-o'-the-wisps leading those brave enough to follow the light in the dark night to vast treasure.
claims.statement_id: Beberapa mitos menggambarkan will-o'-the-wisp memandu orang yang berani mengikuti cahaya menuju harta karun besar.
claims.quote: Few myths, however, show the will-o’-the-wisps leading those brave enough to follow the light in the middle of the dark night to a vast treasure, and riches beyond comprehension.

claims.statement: Some believe the spirits behind will-o'-the-wisps were souls unable to enter Heaven or Hell, forced to wander the earth forever.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian percaya roh will-o'-the-wisp adalah jiwa yang tidak dapat masuk Surga maupun Neraka dan terpaksa mengembara selamanya.
claims.quote: Some believe that the spirits behind the will-o’-the-wisps were souls who could enter neither Heaven nor Hell, and were thus forced to wander the earth forever.

claims.statement: In Sweden, the will-o'-the-wisp is a manifestation of an unbaptised soul trying to lead travellers into water in hopes of baptism.
claims.statement_id: Di Swedia will-o'-the-wisp dipandang sebagai perwujudan jiwa yang belum dibaptis yang menuntun musafir ke perairan demi dibaptis.
claims.quote: Uniquely, in Sweden, the will-o’-the-wisp is a manifestation of an unbaptised soul, who tries to lead travellers into bodies of water, in hopes of being baptised.

claims.statement: Will-o'-the-Wisp is the most common English designation for fairy-beings characterized by fiery appearance and misleading wayfarers.
claims.statement_id: Will-o'-the-Wisp adalah sebutan bahasa Inggris paling umum bagi keluarga makhluk peri berpenampilan api yang suka menyesatkan pejalan malam.
claims.quote: Will-o'-the-Wisp is the most common English designation for a family of fairy-beings characterized by their fiery appearance and their tendency to lead nighttime wayfarers astray.

claims.statement: The term wisp refers to a twist of straw, used as a torch.
claims.statement_id: Istilah wisp merujuk pada pilinan jerami yang digunakan sebagai obor.
claims.quote: The term wisp refers to a twist of straw, used as a torch.

claims.statement: Other names for these apparitions include Hobby-Lantern, Jack-o'-Lantern, Jenny-Burnt-Tale, Kitty-Candlestick, and Peg-a-Lantern.
claims.statement_id: Nama lain untuk penampakan ini mencakup Hobby-Lantern, Jack-o'-Lantern, Jenny-Burnt-Tale, Kitty-Candlestick, dan Peg-a-Lantern.
claims.quote: Other names for these apparitions include Hobby-Lantern, Jack-o'-Lantern, Jenny-Burnt-Tale, Kitty-Candlestick, Peg-a-Lantern, and many more.

claims.statement: The Ellylldan is a species of elf exactly corresponding to the English will-o'-wisp.
claims.statement_id: Ellylldan adalah jenis peri Wales yang berpadanan persis dengan will-o'-wisp Inggris.
claims.quote: The Ellylldan is a species of elf exactly corresponding to the English will-o'-wisp.

claims.statement: Personifications of death are found in many religions and mythologies.
claims.statement_id: Personifikasi kematian ditemukan dalam banyak agama dan mitologi.
claims.quote: Personifications of death are found in many religions and mythologies.

claims.statement: In more modern stories, the Grim Reaper is depicted as a berobed skeleton wielding a scythe to collect souls.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah modern, sosok yang dikenal sebagai Grim Reaper digambarkan sebagai kerangka berjubah pembawa sabit pencabut jiwa.
claims.quote: In more modern stories, a character known as the Grim Reaper (usually depicted as a berobed skeleton wielding a scythe) causes the victim's death by coming to collect that person's soul.

claims.statement: Other beliefs hold that death is a psychopomp, guiding the deceased to the afterlife without controlling when or how they die.
claims.statement_id: Kepercayaan lain memandang kematian sebagai psychopomp yang memandu orang meninggal ke alam baka tanpa mengendalikan kapan atau bagaimana orang itu meninggal.
claims.quote: Other beliefs hold that the spectre of death is only a psychopomp, a benevolent figure who serves to gently sever the last ties between the soul and the body, and to guide the deceased to the afterlife, without having any control over when or how the victim dies.

claims.statement: Death is most often personified in male form, although in certain cultures it is perceived as female, such as Santa Muerte in Mexico.
claims.statement_id: Kematian kerap dipersonifikasikan dalam wujud pria, meski di budaya tertentu berwujud perempuan seperti Santa Muerte di Mexico.
claims.quote: Death is most often personified in male form, although in certain cultures death is perceived as female (for instance, Marzanna in Slavic mythology, or Santa Muerte in Mexico).

claims.statement: Death is also portrayed as one of the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse.
claims.statement_id: Kematian juga digambarkan sebagai salah satu dari Empat Penunggang Kuda Apokalips.
claims.quote: Death is also portrayed as one of the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse.

claims.statement: In Aztec mythology, Mictecacihuatl rules over the Mictlan underworld with her husband Mictlantecuhtli.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Aztek, Mictecacihuatl memerintah alam baka bawah tanah Mictlan bersama suaminya Mictlantecuhtli.
claims.quote: In Aztec mythology, Mictecacihuatl is the "Queen of Mictlan" (the Aztec underworld), ruling over the afterlife with her husband, Mictlantecuhtli.

claims.statement: A common term for the personification of death across Latin America is la Parca.
claims.statement_id: Sebutan umum bagi personifikasi kematian di Latin America adalah la Parca.
claims.quote: A common term for the personification of death across Latin America is "la Parca" from one of the three Roman Parcae, a figure similar to the Anglophone Grim Reaper, though usually depicted as female and without a scythe.

claims.statement: In Poland, kostucha has an appearance similar to the Grim Reaper with a white robe.
claims.statement_id: Di Poland, kostucha memiliki penampilan mirip Grim Reaper dengan jubah putih.
claims.quote: In Poland, Death – Śmierć or kostucha – has an appearance similar to the Grim Reaper, although its robe was traditionally white instead of black.

claims.statement: Thanatos was the god or personified spirit of non-violent death.
claims.statement_id: Thanatos adalah dewa atau roh yang mempersonifikasikan kematian tanpa kekerasan.
claims.quote: THANATOS was the god or personified spirit ( daimon ) of non-violent death.

claims.statement: Thanatos' touch was gentle, likened to that of his twin brother Hypnos.
claims.statement_id: Sentuhan Thanatos lembut, diserupakan dengan saudara kembarnya Hypnos.
claims.quote: His touch was gentle, likened to that of his twin brother Hypnos (Sleep).

claims.statement: Violent death was the domain of Thanatos' sisters, the Keres.
claims.statement_id: Kematian akibat kekerasan merupakan ranah saudari-saudari Thanatos, yaitu Keres.
claims.quote: Violent death was the domain of Thanatos' blood-craving sisters, the Keres , spirits of slaughter and disease.

claims.statement: In Greek vase painting Thanatos was depicted as a winged, bearded older man.
claims.statement_id: Dalam lukisan vas Greek, Thanatos digambarkan sebagai pria tua bersayap dan berjanggut.
claims.quote: In Greek vase painting Thanatos was depicted as a winged, bearded older man, or more rarely as a beardless youth.

claims.statement: In Roman sculptural reliefs he was portrayed as a youth holding a down-turned torch and butterfly symbolizing the soul.
claims.statement_id: Dalam relief patung Romawi, ia digambarkan sebagai pemuda pemegang obor terbalik dan kupu-kupu yang melambangkan jiwa.
claims.quote: In Roman sculptural reliefs he was portrayed as a youth holding a down-turned torch and wreath or butterfly which symbolised the soul of the dead.

claims.statement: Psychopomp comes from the Greek word ψυχοπομπός, literally translating as the guide of souls.
claims.statement_id: Kata psychopomp berasal dari bahasa Greek ψυχοπομπός yang berarti pemandu jiwa.
claims.quote: psychopomp itself comes from the Greek word ψυχοπομπός , which literally translates as ‘the guide of souls’.

claims.statement: It is the name given to a creature, spirit or deity who escorts people to the afterlife.
claims.statement_id: Psychopomp adalah sebutan bagi makhluk, roh, atau dewa yang mengawal manusia ke alam baka.
claims.quote: It is the name given to a creature, spirit or deity who escorts people to the afterlife.

claims.statement: There is debate about whether the Grim Reaper can be classified as a psychopomp or whether it brings about death instead.
claims.statement_id: Terdapat perdebatan apakah Grim Reaper dapat diklasifikasikan sebagai psychopomp ataukah sosok pembawa kematian.
claims.quote: there is some debate about whether the Grim Reaper, the most popular personification of Death, can be classified as a psychopomp, or whether it brings about death instead.

claims.statement: Some stories believe the Reaper has no control over when a person dies, only severing ties and guiding the deceased to the afterlife.
claims.statement_id: Beberapa cerita memandang Reaper tidak berkuasa atas waktu kematian dan hanya bertugas memutus ikatan jiwa lalu membimbingnya ke alam baka.
claims.quote: Some stories believe that the Reaper has no control over when or how a person dies, and its only role is to sever the final ties between the soul and the body, guiding the deceased to the afterlife.

claims.statement: Baphomet is a figure rooted within the occult and Western esoteric traditions.
claims.statement_id: Baphomet berakar dalam tradisi okultisme dan esoterisme Barat.
claims.quote: Baphomet is a figure rooted within the occult and Western esoteric traditions.

claims.statement: The name first emerged in the 14th century during the Trials of the Knights Templar when the order was accused of worshipping Baphomet as a demonic idol.
claims.statement_id: Nama Baphomet pertama kali muncul pada abad ke-14 dalam pengadilan Knights Templar yang dituduh memujanya sebagai berhala iblis.
claims.quote: The name first emerged in the 14th century during the Trials of the Knights Templar, when the order was accused of heresy for worshipping Baphomet as a demonic idol.

claims.statement: The modern popular image of Baphomet was established by Éliphas Lévi in his 1856 work Dogme et Rituel de la Haute Magie.
claims.statement_id: Citra modern Baphomet dibentuk oleh Éliphas Lévi pada tahun 1856 dalam karyanya Dogme et Rituel de la Haute Magie.
claims.quote: The modern popular image of Baphomet was established by Éliphas Lévi in his 1856 work Dogme et Rituel de la Haute Magie.

claims.statement: His Sabbatic Goat illustration depicts a winged human-goat hybrid representing perfect equilibrium.
claims.statement_id: Ilustrasi Sabbatic Goat menampilkan makhluk hibrida manusia dan kambing bersayap yang melambangkan keseimbangan sempurna.
claims.quote: His Sabbatic Goat illustration depicts a winged, androgynous human-goat hybrid, a deliberate synthesis of binary opposites designed to represent the concept of perfect equilibrium.

claims.statement: Baphomet is a symbol of occultism representing the reconciliation of opposites and esoteric knowledge.
claims.statement_id: Baphomet menjadi simbol okultisme untuk rekonsiliasi hal-hal yang berlawanan dan pengetahuan esoteris.
claims.quote: This Baphomet is a recurring symbol of occultism, widely adapted to represent the reconciliation of opposites, esoteric knowledge, and the summation of the universe.

claims.statement: Bafomet comes from Medieval Latin Baphometh or Bafometz, revived in the 19th century as a figure of occultism and Satanism.
claims.statement_id: Bafomet berasal dari bahasa Latin Abad Pertengahan Baphometh atau Bafometz yang dihidupkan kembali pada abad ke-19 sebagai figur okultisme dan setanisme.
claims.quote: Bafomet (pengucapan bahasa Inggris: [ˈbæfɵmɛt], dari Bahasa Latin Abad Pertengahan Baphometh, baffometi, Bafometz) adalah suatu sosok imajinasi dewa berbentuk rusa pagan (yaitu sebuah produk cerita rakyat mengenai kaum pagan) yang dihidupkan kembali pada abad ke-19 sebagai figur okultisme dan setanisme.

claims.statement: The name appeared in 19th-century English debates regarding the suppression of the Knights Templar.
claims.statement_id: Nama ini muncul dalam percakapan Inggris pada abad ke-19 seputar penindasan Kesatria Kenisah.
claims.quote: Nama ini muncul pertama kali dalam pengertian bahasa percakapan Inggris popular pada abad ke-19 dalam perdebatan dan spekulasi mengenai alasan-alasan penindasan terhadap Kesatria Kenisah.

claims.statement: It is the name of a Gaulish goddess who was worshiped in the Black Forest and surrounding areas.
claims.statement_id: Abnoba adalah dewi Gaulish yang dipuja di kawasan Black Forest dan sekitarnya.
claims.quote: It is the name of a Gaulish goddess who was worshiped in the Black Forest and surrounding areas.

claims.statement: Abnoba has been interpreted to be a forest and river goddess, known from about nine epigraphic inscriptions.
claims.statement_id: Abnoba ditafsirkan sebagai dewi hutan dan sungai, dan dikenal dari sekitar sembilan prasasti.
claims.quote: Abnoba has been interpreted to be a forest and river goddess, and is known from about nine epigraphic inscriptions.

claims.statement: One altar at the Roman baths at Badenweiler, Germany, and another at Mühlenbach identify her with Diana, the Roman goddess of the hunt.
claims.statement_id: Altar di pemandian Roman di Badenweiler, Germany, dan Mühlenbach menyamakannya dengan dewi Diana.
claims.quote: One altar at the Roman baths at Badenweiler, Germany, and another at Mühlenbach identify her with Diana, the Roman goddess of the hunt.

claims.statement: The etymology of the theonym is uncertain.
claims.statement_id: Etimologi nama dewi ini tidak pasti.
claims.quote: The etymology of the theonym is uncertain.

claims.statement: It has been associated with the etymon *abo-s meaning water or river.
claims.statement_id: Nama ini dikaitkan dengan kata dasar *abo-s yang berarti air atau sungai.
claims.quote: It has been associated with the etymon *abo-s "water, river", found in e.g. Avon (*abonā).

claims.statement: Abnoba is a female deity of the Celtic religion.
claims.statement_id: Abnoba adalah dewi dalam agama Celtic.
claims.quote: Abnoba ist eine weibliche Gottheit der keltischen Religion.

claims.statement: The goddess personified the Black Forest, which in antiquity bore the name Abnoba mons.
claims.statement_id: Dewi ini mempersonifikasikan Schwarzwald yang pada masa kuno bernama Abnoba mons.
claims.quote: Die Göttin personifizierte den Schwarzwald, der in der Antike den Namen Abnoba mons trug.

claims.statement: According to the interpretatio Romana, she is considered the Celtic counterpart of the hunt goddess Diana.
claims.statement_id: Menurut interpretatio Romana, ia dipandang sebagai padanan dewi pemburu Diana.
claims.quote: Nach der Interpretatio Romana gilt sie als das keltische Pendant der Jagdgöttin Diana.

claims.statement: A sylph is an air spirit from the 16th-century works of Paracelsus, who describes sylphs as invisible beings of the air.
claims.statement_id: Sylph atau sylphid adalah roh udara yang berasal dari karya abad ke-16 oleh Paracelsus yang menggambarkannya sebagai makhluk udara yang tidak terlihat.
claims.quote: A sylph (also called sylphid) is an air spirit stemming from the 16th-century works of Paracelsus, who describes sylphs as (invisible) beings of the air, his elementals of air.

claims.statement: The Swiss-German physician and alchemist Paracelsus coined the term sylph in the 16th century to describe an air spirit among four Classical elements.
claims.statement_id: Alkemis Swiss-German Paracelsus menciptakan istilah sylph pada abad ke-16 untuk menggambarkan roh udara dalam skema empat elemen klasik.
claims.quote: The Swiss–German physician and alchemist Theophrastus von Hohenheim ("Paracelsus") first coined the term sylph in the 16th century to describe an air spirit in his overarching scheme of elemental spirits associated with the four Classical elements.

claims.statement: Sylph is possibly a blend of Latin sylvestris and nympha.
claims.statement_id: Sylph kemungkinan merupakan perpaduan dari kata Latin sylvestris dan nympha.
claims.quote: "Sylph" is possibly a blend of from Latin sylvestris and nympha, sylvestris being a common synonym for sylph in Paracelsus.

claims.statement: Silvestris is taken as an elliptical form of nympha silvestris meaning forest nymph.
claims.statement_id: Silvestris dipandang sebagai bentuk pendek dari nympha silvestris yang berarti nimfa hutan.
claims.quote: Anthony Trollope notes a similar usage in the Aeneid, where silvestris is taken as an elliptical form of nympha silvestris ("forest nymph").

claims.statement: Sylphs or Sylvani are mythical nature spirits associated with the element of air.
claims.statement_id: Sylphen atau Sylvani adalah roh alam mistis yang dikaitkan dengan elemen udara.
claims.quote: Sylphen oder auch Sylvani sind mythische Naturgeister, die dem Element Luft zugeordnet sind, so wie Undinen Wassergeister sind.

claims.statement: Paracelsus is considered the literary creator of sylphs.
claims.statement_id: Paracelsus dipandang sebagai pencipta literer dari sylph.
claims.quote: Paracelsus (1493–1541) gilt als literarischer Schöpfer der Sylphen.

claims.statement: Up to the first half of the 20th century graceful girls were called Sylphide after the ballet La Sylphide.
claims.statement_id: Hingga paruh pertama abad ke-20 gadis anggun disebut sebagai Sylphide berdasarkan balet La Sylphide.
claims.quote: Bis in die erste Hälfte des 20. Jahrhunderts bezeichnete man auch ein zartes und anmutiges Mädchen als Sylphide (nach dem Ballett La Sylphide).

claims.statement: A hag is a wizened old woman, or a kind of fairy, witch, or goddess in folklore and children's tales.
claims.statement_id: Hag adalah perempuan tua keriput, atau jenis peri, penyihir, atau dewi berwujud perempuan tersebut dalam cerita rakyat dan dongeng.
claims.quote: A hag is a wizened old woman, or a kind of fairy, witch, or goddess having the appearance of such a woman, often found in folklore and children's tales such as "Hansel and Gretel".

claims.statement: Hags are often seen as malevolent, but may also be chosen forms of shapeshifting deities such as The Morrígan or Badb.
claims.statement_id: Hag sering dipandang jahat, tetapi dapat menjadi bentuk pilihan dewi pengubah wujud seperti The Morrígan atau Badb.
claims.quote: Hags are often seen as malevolent, but may also be one of the chosen forms of shapeshifting deities, such as The Morrígan or Badb, who are seen as neither wholly benevolent nor malevolent.

claims.statement: The term appears in Middle English from Old English hægtesse for witch, related to Dutch heks and German Hexe.
claims.statement_id: Istilah ini muncul dalam Middle English dari hægtesse dalam Old English yang berarti penyihir, seakar dengan heks dan Hexe.
claims.quote: The term appears in Middle English, and was a shortening of hægtesse, an Old English term for 'witch'; similarly the Dutch heks and German Hexe are also shortenings, of the Middle Dutch haghetisse and Old High German hagzusa, respectively.

claims.statement: All of these words derive from Proto-Germanic *hagatusjon-, the first element possibly related to hedge.
claims.statement_id: Kata-kata ini diturunkan dari Proto-Germanic *hagatusjon- yang elemen awalnya mungkin berkaitan dengan kata hedge.
claims.quote: All of these words are derived from the Proto-Germanic *hagatusjon- which is of unknown origin; the first element may be related to the word hedge.

claims.statement: The word hag can also be synonymous for a witch.
claims.statement_id: Kata hag juga dapat bersinonim dengan penyihir.
claims.quote: The word hag can also be synonymous for a witch.

claims.statement: A hag is an imaginary folklore creature related to fairies, possessing supernatural powers and practicing witchcraft.
claims.statement_id: Hag adalah makhluk imajiner cerita rakyat yang berkerabat dengan peri, memiliki kekuatan supranatural dan mempraktikkan sihir.
claims.quote: Une hag est une créature imaginaire issue du folklore anglo-saxon et apparentée aux fées, ayant des pouvoirs surnaturels et pratiquant la sorcellerie.

claims.statement: She has the appearance of an ugly and very old woman, malevolent and dangerous.
claims.statement_id: Ia berpenampilan perempuan buruk rupa dan sangat tua, jahat serta berbahaya.
claims.quote: Elle a l'apparence d'une femme laide et très vieille, malveillante et dangereuse.

claims.statement: Murmur is a Great Duke and Earl of Hell, having 30 legions of demons under his command.
claims.statement_id: Murmur adalah Great Duke and Earl of Hell yang memimpin 30 legiun iblis.
claims.quote: Murmur (also Murmus, Murmuur, Murmux) is a Great Duke and Earl of Hell, having 30 legions of demons under his command.

claims.statement: He teaches philosophy, and can oblige the souls of the deceased to appear before the conjurer to answer every desired question.
claims.statement_id: Ia mengajarkan filsafat dan dapat memaksa arwah orang mati untuk hadir menjawab pertanyaan pemanggilnya.
claims.quote: He teaches philosophy, and can oblige the souls of the deceased to appear before the conjurer to answer every desired question.

claims.statement: Murmur is depicted as a soldier riding a vulture or a griffin, and wearing a ducal crown.
claims.statement_id: Murmur digambarkan sebagai prajurit yang menunggangi burung nasar atau griffin dan mengenakan mahkota adipati.
claims.quote: Murmur is depicted as a soldier riding a vulture or a griffin, and wearing a ducal crown.

claims.statement: Two of his ministers go before him making the sound of trumpets.
claims.statement_id: Dua menterinya berjalan di depannya menghasilkan suara terompet.
claims.quote: Two of his ministers go before him making the sound of trumpets.

claims.statement: Murmur in Latin means noise, whisper, murmur, and the sound of the trumpet.
claims.statement_id: Nama Murmur dalam bahasa Latin berarti kebisingan, bisikan, desas-desus, dan suara terompet.
claims.quote: "Murmur" in Latin means noise, whisper, murmur, and the sound of the trumpet.

claims.statement: Murmur is a demon from the beliefs of goetia.
claims.statement_id: Murmur adalah iblis yang berasal dari kepercayaan goetia.
claims.quote: Murmur, Murmus, Murmuur ou Murmux est un démon issu des croyances de la goétie, science occulte de l'invocation d'entités démoniaques.

claims.statement: He is the 54th demon on the Lemegeton list and the 40th on the Pseudomonarchia daemonum list.
claims.statement_id: Ia terdaftar sebagai iblis ke-54 dalam Lemegeton dan ke-40 dalam Pseudomonarchia daemonum.
claims.quote: Grand Duc et Comte des Enfers, il est le 54e démon de la liste du Lemegeton et le 40e de la liste du Pseudomonarchia daemonum.

claims.statement: Aveta was a Gaulish goddess worshipped chiefly among the Treveri in the region of Trier.
claims.statement_id: Aveta adalah dewi Gaulish yang dipuja terutama di kalangan Treveri di kawasan Trier.
claims.quote: Aveta was a Gaulish goddess worshipped chiefly among the Treveri, in the region of Trier.

claims.statement: She was a mother goddess associated with fertility, known from an altar and small terracotta figurines.
claims.statement_id: Ia adalah dewi ibu yang dikaitkan dengan kesuburan dan dikenal dari altar serta patung terakota.
claims.quote: She was a mother goddess associated with fertility, and is known there from an altar and from small terracotta figurines.

claims.statement: Her name is recorded on two inscriptions from the Altbachtal temple precinct at Trier and a dedication from Mont-Afrique.
claims.statement_id: Namanya tercatat pada dua prasasti dari kompleks kuil Altbachtal di Trier dan persembahan dari Mont-Afrique.
claims.quote: Her name is recorded on two inscriptions from the Altbachtal temple precinct at Trier, and on a dedication from Mont-Afrique in Burgundy.

claims.statement: In the Altbachtal temple precinct at Trier, an altar naming her was recovered from Building 17.
claims.statement_id: Di kompleks kuil Altbachtal di Trier, altar yang memuat namanya ditemukan di Gedung 17.
claims.quote: In the Altbachtal temple precinct at Trier, an altar naming her was recovered from one of the temples, Building 17.

claims.statement: Similar clay figurines were dedicated at a rural sanctuary at nearby Dhronecken.
claims.statement_id: Patung tanah liat serupa dipersembahkan di tempat suci pedesaan di Dhronecken terdekat.
claims.quote: Similar clay figurines were dedicated at a rural sanctuary at Dhronecken nearby.

claims.statement: In the Gallo-Roman religion, Dea Aveta was a mother goddess associated with the spring of Trier.
claims.statement_id: Dalam agama Gallo-Roman, Dea Aveta adalah dewi ibu yang dikaitkan dengan mata air Trier.
claims.quote: Dans la religion gallo-romaine, Dea Aveta était une déesse mère, associé à la source de Trèves dans ce qui est aujourd'hui l'Allemagne.

claims.statement: These figurines show the goddess with a suckling child, small dogs, or fruit baskets.
claims.statement_id: Figurin-figurin tersebut menampilkan sang dewi bersama anak yang menyusu, anjing-anjing kecil, atau keranjang buah.
claims.quote: Ces figurines montrent la déesse avec un enfant à la mamelle, des petits chiens, ou des paniers de fruits.

claims.statement: Dantalion is a Great Duke of Hell, having 36 legions of demons under his command; he is the 71st of the 72 spirits of Solomon.
claims.statement_id: Dantalion adalah Great Duke of Hell yang memimpin 36 legiun iblis sebagai roh ke-71.
claims.quote: Dantalion (also Dantalian) is a powerful Great Duke of Hell, having 36 legions of demons under his command; he is the 71st of the 72 spirits of Solomon.

claims.statement: He teaches all arts and sciences, and declares the secret counsel of anyone, knowing the thoughts of all people and changing them at will.
claims.statement_id: Ia mengajarkan segala seni dan ilmu pengetahuan, serta mengetahui pikiran semua orang dan mampu mengubahnya sesuai kehendaknya.
claims.quote: He teaches all arts and sciences, and also declares the secret counsel of anyone, given that he knows the thoughts of all people and can change them at his will.

claims.statement: He can cause love and show the similitude of any person by means of a vision.
claims.statement_id: Ia dapat menumbuhkan cinta dan memperlihatkan keserupaan seseorang melalui penglihatan.
claims.quote: He can also cause love and show the similitude of any person, show the same by means of a vision, and let them be in any part of the world they will.

claims.statement: He is depicted as a man with many appearances, having the faces of all men and women.
claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan sebagai pria dengan banyak rupa, memiliki wajah seluruh pria dan wanita.
claims.quote: He is depicted as a man with many appearances, which means he has the faces of all men and women.

claims.statement: There are also many depictions in which he is said to hold a book in one of his hands.
claims.statement_id: Banyak penggambaran menyebutkan ia memegang sebuah buku di salah satu tangannya.
claims.quote: There are also many depictions in which he is said to hold a book in one of his hands.

claims.statement: Dantalion is a demon from the beliefs of goetia.
claims.statement_id: Dantalion adalah iblis yang berasal dari kepercayaan goetia.
claims.quote: Dantalion est un démon issu des croyances de la goétie, science occulte de l'invocation d'entités démoniaques.

claims.statement: The Lemegeton mentions him in the 71st position of its list of demons.
claims.statement_id: Lemegeton mencantumkannya di posisi ke-71 dalam daftar iblisnya.
claims.quote: Le Lemegeton le mentionne en 71e position de sa liste de démons tandis que la Pseudomonarchia daemonum ne le mentionne pas.

claims.statement: Pichal peri is the name given to the churel in northwestern South Asia and Central Asia appearing as a woman with long hair and backward feet.
claims.statement_id: Pichal peri adalah nama untuk churel di barat laut South Asia dan Central Asia yang berwujud perempuan berambut panjang dan berkaki terbalik.
claims.quote: is the name given to the churel in northwestern South Asia and Central Asia because of their typical appearance as a woman with long hair covering the face and feet pointing backward.

claims.statement: Some versions claim they have inverted faces, only attack men, and are also known as Daan.
claims.statement_id: Beberapa versi menyebut mereka memiliki wajah terbalik, hanya menyerang pria, dan dikenal sebagai Daan.
claims.quote: Some versions claim they have inverted faces as well and only attack men. They are also known as Daan.

claims.statement: Pichal peris are said to roam the mountains of India and Pakistan, especially in the Himalayas.
claims.statement_id: Pichal peri dikatakan berkeliaran di pegunungan India dan Pakistan, khususnya Himalayas.
claims.quote: Pichal peris are said to roam the mountains of India and Pakistan. They are said to be found in the Himalayas, though they occasionally enter some Indian villages.

claims.statement: They appear as beautiful women to lure men and can transform into tall demonic creatures.
claims.statement_id: Mereka kerap berwujud perempuan cantik untuk memikat pria dan dapat berubah menjadi makhluk iblis tinggi.
claims.quote: In most stories they appear as beautiful women in order to lure men and get exposed only due to their backward feet. In some cases witnesses claim to see the female form transforming into a tall demonic creature.

claims.statement: In Indian-Pakistani folklore this creature targets men passing through woods after dark.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat India-Pakistan makhluk ini menargetkan pria yang melintasi hutan setelah hari gelap.
claims.quote: In the Indian-Pakistani folklores, it has two forms, one is of a witch who is very dark, ugly and scary, and another is of a beautiful woman who targets vulnerable men passing through the woods after the dark; they appear and vanish after a while, leaving a fearful experience to the victims.

claims.statement: It has long hair, long teeth, and feet that are reversed with heel in front and toes turned back.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini memiliki rambut panjang, gigi panjang, dan kaki terbalik dengan tumit di depan serta jari di belakang.
claims.quote: According to them, it has long hair and long teeth and feet that are reversed (with heel in front and toes turned back).

claims.statement: He dominates insubordinate and stubborn persons and commands 36 infernal legions.
claims.statement_id: Ia menguasai orang-orang yang membangkang dan keras kepala serta memimpin 36 legiun neraka.
claims.quote: Il domine les personnes insubordonnées et têtues et commande 36 légions infernales.

claims.statement: He is invoked to acquire scholarly knowledge in various crafts or the gift of philosophy.
claims.statement_id: Ia dipanggil untuk memperoleh pengetahuan dalam berbagai keahlian dan kepandaian filsafat.
claims.quote: On l'invoque pour acquérir des connaissances savantes dans divers métiers ou le don de philosophie.

claims.statement: Vapula is depicted as a griffin-winged lion.
claims.statement_id: Vapula digambarkan sebagai singa dengan sayap griffin.
claims.quote: Vapula is depicted as a griffin-winged lion.

claims.statement: Vapula is a demon from the beliefs of goetia.
claims.statement_id: Vapula adalah iblis dari kepercayaan goetia.
claims.quote: Vapula, Nappula ou Naphula est un démon issu des croyances de la goétie, science occulte de l'invocation d'entités démoniaques.

claims.statement: The Lemegeton mentions him in the 60th position with the title of duke.
claims.statement_id: Lemegeton mencantumkannya di posisi ke-60 dengan gelar adipati.
claims.quote: Le Lemegeton le mentionne en 60e position de sa liste de démons. Selon cet ouvrage, Vapula possède le titre de duc.

claims.statement: He is generally represented in the form of a lion with wings of an eagle or griffin.
claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan dalam wujud singa bersayap elang atau griffin.
claims.quote: On le représente en général sous la forme d'un lion avec des ailes d'aigle ou de griffon.

claims.statement: Pseudomonarchia Daemonum mentions him in the 59th position with similar characteristics.
claims.statement_id: Pseudomonarchia Daemonum menyebutnya di posisi ke-59 dengan karakteristik serupa.
claims.quote: La Pseudomonarchia Daemonum le mentionne en 59e position de sa liste de démons et lui attribue des caractéristiques similaires.

claims.statement: Vepar is a strong Great Duke of Hell, ruling over 29 legions of demons.
claims.statement_id: Vepar adalah adipati neraka yang memerintah 29 legiun iblis.
claims.quote: Vepar (also Separ, Vephar) is a strong Great Duke of Hell, ruling over 29 legions of demons.

claims.statement: He governs the waters, guides armoured ships, and can make the sea rough and stormy.
claims.statement_id: Ia menguasai perairan, memandu kapal bersenjata, dan mampu memicu badai di lautan.
claims.quote: He governs the waters and guides armoured ships laden with ammunition and weapons. He can also make, if requested, the sea rough and stormy, and to appear full of ships.

claims.statement: Vepar is depicted as a two-tailed mermaid.
claims.statement_id: Vepar digambarkan sebagai putri duyung berekor ganda.
claims.quote: Vepar is depicted as a two-tailed mermaid.

claims.statement: Vepar can cause mortals to die in three days by putrefying wounds, yet can heal them immediately on request.
claims.statement_id: Vepar dapat membunuh manusia lewat luka membusuk dalam tiga hari, namun dapat menyembuhkannya bila diminta.
claims.quote: Vepar can also make men die in three days by putrefying sores and wounds, causing worms to breed in them, but if requested by the conjurer, he can and will heal them immediately.

claims.statement: Vepar is a demon from the beliefs of goetia.
claims.statement_id: Vepar adalah roh jahat dalam ilmu sihir goetia.
claims.quote: Vepar ou Sépar est un démon issu des croyances de la goétie, science occulte de l'invocation d'entités démoniaques.

claims.statement: The Lemegeton lists him in 42nd position and the Pseudomonarchia daemonum in 33rd position.
claims.statement_id: Lemegeton mencantumkannya di peringkat ke-42 dan Pseudomonarchia daemonum di peringkat ke-33.
claims.quote: Le Lemegeton le mentionne en 42e position de sa liste de démons tandis que la Pseudomonarchia daemonum le mentionne en 33e position.

claims.statement: Vepar appears in the form of a siren and guides merchant vessels.
claims.statement_id: Vepar menampakkan diri dalam wujud putri duyung dan mengarahkan kapal.
claims.quote: Puissant et redoutable duc du sombre empire, Vepar se montre sous la forme d'une sirène et conduit les vaisseaux marchands.

claims.statement: Vual is a mighty Great Duke of Hell, commanding 37 legions of demons.
claims.statement_id: Vual adalah adipati neraka yang memimpin 37 legiun iblis.
claims.quote: Vual (also Uvall, Voval, Vreal, Wal, Wall) is a mighty Great Duke of Hell, commanding 37 legions of demons.

claims.statement: He gives the love of women, causes friendship between friends and foes, and tells things past, present and to come.
claims.statement_id: Ia menganugerahkan cinta wanita, mendamaikan sahabat dan musuh, serta meramal masa lalu, kini, dan nanti.
claims.quote: He gives the love of women, causes friendship between friends and foes, and tells things past, present and to come.

claims.statement: Vual is depicted as a dromedary that changes shape into a man, speaking the Egyptian language with a deep voice.
claims.statement_id: Vual berwujud dromedari yang berubah rupa menjadi pria dan berbicara bahasa Egyptian dengan suara berat.
claims.quote: Vual is depicted as a dromedary that after a while changes shape into a man, and speaks the Egyptian language, but not perfectly, with a deep voice.

claims.statement: Vual is a demon from the beliefs of goetia.
claims.statement_id: Vual adalah roh jahat dalam kepercayaan goetia.
claims.quote: Vual, Uvall ou Voval est un démon issu des croyances de la goétie, science occulte de l'invocation d'entités démoniaques.

claims.statement: The Lemegeton lists him in 47th position as a great and powerful duke of hell.
claims.statement_id: Lemegeton mencatatnya pada urutan ke-47 sebagai adipati agung neraka.
claims.quote: Le Lemegeton le mentionne en 47e position de sa liste de démons. Selon cet ouvrage, Vual serait un grand et puissant duc de l'enfer.

claims.statement: His appearance is that of a dromedary with two legs and two arms, with the overall look of a hunchback.
claims.statement_id: Wujudnya seperti dromedari berkaki dua dan berlengan dua dengan rupa bungkuk.
claims.quote: Son apparence est celle d'un dromadaire à deux pattes et deux bras, ayant une allure générale de bossu.

claims.statement: The Pseudomonarchia Daemonum mentions him in 66th position on its list of demons.
claims.statement_id: Pseudomonarchia Daemonum menyebutnya pada urutan ke-66 dalam daftar iblisnya.
claims.quote: La Pseudomonarchia Daemonum le mentionne en 66e position de sa liste de démons et lui attribue des caractéristiques similaires.

claims.statement: In Mande mythology, Faro purified the earth by sacrificing himself to atone for his twin Pemba's sin.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Mande, Faro menyucikan bumi untuk menebus dosa saudara kembarnya Pemba.
claims.quote: In Mande mythology, Faro purified the earth by sacrificing himself to atone for his twin Pemba's sin.

claims.statement: Faro, a symbol of femininity and creation, was accompanied by her male counterpart, Koni.
claims.statement_id: Faro melambangkan femininitas dan penciptaan, didampingi pasangan laki-lakinya Koni.
claims.quote: Faro, a symbol of femininity and creation, was accompanied by her male counterpart, Koni, who derived his existence from her.

claims.statement: Faro's crowning achievement was the creation of the Niger River, ensuring sustenance and vitality for all life.
claims.statement_id: Pencapaian utama Faro adalah penciptaan sungai Niger untuk memberi kehidupan bagi semua makhluk.
claims.quote: Faro's crowning achievement was the creation of the Niger River, ensuring sustenance and vitality for all life.

claims.statement: Fâro is a West African water deity found notably in Malinké and Bambara cultures.
claims.statement_id: Fâro adalah dewa air Afrika Barat yang terdapat dalam budaya Malinké dan Bambara.
claims.quote: Fâro (ou Faro) est une divinité de l'eau ouest-africaine présente notamment dans les cultures malinké et bambara.

claims.statement: It is closely linked to the Niger River in the religions and myths of peoples living on its banks.
claims.statement_id: Ia terikat erat dengan sungai Niger dalam agama dan mitos masyarakat di bantarannya.
claims.quote: Elle est étroitement liée au fleuve Niger dans les religions et les mythes des peuples qui vivent sur ses rives.

claims.statement: Depending on cultures, Fâro is represented as a god or as a goddess.
claims.statement_id: Tergantung pada kebudayaannya, Fâro digambarkan sebagai dewa laki-laki atau dewi perempuan.
claims.quote: Selon les cultures, Fâro est représenté comme un dieu ou comme une déesse.

claims.statement: Fâro holds an important role in the Bambara creation myth common across West Africa.
claims.statement_id: Fâro memegang peran penting dalam mitos penciptaan dunia masyarakat Bambara di Afrika Barat.
claims.quote: Fâro tient un rôle important dans le mythe bambara de création du monde, mythe dont les grandes lignes sont communes aux Bambaras et à plusieurs autres populations d'Afrique de l'Ouest.

claims.statement: Abrahel is a succubus described by Nicholas Rémy in his work Daemonolatreiae libri tres.
claims.statement_id: Abrahel adalah succubus yang diuraikan oleh Nicholas Rémy dalam bukunya Daemonolatreiae libri tres.
claims.quote: Abrahel is a succubus described by Nicholas Rémy in his work Daemonolatreiae libri tres.

claims.statement: According to Rémy, Abrahel appeared in 1581 in Dalhem, seducing Pierron and tricking him into killing his son.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Rémy, Abrahel muncul pada 1581 di Dalhem, memikat pria bernama Pierron dan memperdayainya membunuh putranya.
claims.quote: According to Rémy, Abrahel appeared in 1581 in the village of Dalhem, seduced a man called Pierron and tricked him to kill his own son.

claims.statement: Pierron implored the demon to revive his son, and the succubus agreed in exchange for worship.
claims.statement_id: Pierron memohon agar anaknya dihidupkan kembali, dan succubus itu setuju dengan imbalan pemujaan.
claims.quote: After the murder, Pierron regretted what he had done and implored the demon to give life back to his son; the succubus consented but in exchange, demanded the man worship it.

claims.statement: The revived son was slower and skinnier before dying again a year later.
claims.statement_id: Anak itu hidup kembali dalam kondisi kurus dan lambat sebelum akhirnya wafat setahun kemudian.
claims.quote: When the man's son came back from the dead, he wasn't as intelligent as before; he was also skinnier and slower. A mere year later the young died again, and a nauseating smell started to emanate from the corpse.

claims.statement: Abrahel is a succubus that appeared in 1581 in Limbourg, described by Nicolas Rémy.
claims.statement_id: Abrahel adalah succubus yang muncul pada 1581 di Limbourg dan dicatat oleh Nicolas Rémy.
claims.quote: Abrahel serait un succube (démon femelle) apparue en 1581 dans le Limbourg et décrit par Nicolas Rémy dans son ouvrage  Démonolâtrie (1592).

claims.statement: A succubus demon taking the features of a desired woman.
claims.statement_id: Iblis succubus ini mengambil rupa wanita yang diinginkan.
claims.quote: Démon succube qui prend les traits de la femme convoitée et qui peut d'ailleurs se faire féconder à sa place.

claims.statement: In 1581, the demon showed itself to a shepherd named Pierron in Dalhem.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1581, iblis ini menampakkan diri kepada gembala bernama Pierron di Dalhem.
claims.quote: En 1581, le démon se serait montré à un berger dénommé Pierron, au village de Dalhem, dans le Limbourg.

claims.statement: Kianda is a goddess of the sea and protector of fishermen in Angolan culture.
claims.statement_id: Kianda adalah dewi laut dan pelindung nelayan dalam budaya tradisional Angola.
claims.quote: Kianda (or Dandalunda) is a goddess of the sea, of the waters, and a protector of fishermen in traditional Angolan culture.

claims.statement: Kianda was worshipped by throwing offerings of food and clothing into the sea.
claims.statement_id: Kianda dipuja dengan melemparkan persembahan makanan dan pakaian ke laut.
claims.quote: Kianda was traditionally worshipped by throwing offerings such as food and clothing into the sea.

claims.statement: Every year the Luanda Island Feast is held to honor the deity.
claims.statement_id: Setiap tahun perayaan Luanda Island Feast diadakan untuk menghormatinya.
claims.quote: Every year the Luanda Island Feast is held to honor the deity.

claims.statement: Angolan author Pepetela features Kianda in his work O Desejo de Kianda.
claims.statement_id: Penulis Angola Pepetela menggunakan figur Kianda dalam karyanya O Desejo de Kianda.
claims.quote: The Angolan author Pepetela uses the Kianda as a central figure in his short story "Magias do Mar" as well as his novel O Desejo de Kianda

claims.statement: Dandalunda or Quianda in Bantu mythology is a spirit of fresh waters, fertility, and beauty.
claims.statement_id: Dandalunda atau Quianda dalam mitologi Bantu adalah inquice air tawar, kesuburan, dan keindahan.
claims.quote: Dandalunda, Dandaluna ou Dandalunga (do quimbundo e quicongo: Ndanda Lunda), e ainda Angoleira, Caçanje, Caiaia, Dandá, Dandazumba, Gongombera, Iadalunda, Lamazi, Malemba, Mameto-Quissimbe, Mãe-Dalunda, Micaia, Mucunã, Pandá, Quianda, Quissambô, Quissimbi, Quissimbi-Quiamaza, Sereia-Mucunã, na mitologia bantu, é a inquice das águas doces, fertilidade, fecundação, ouro, amor, beleza e riqueza.

claims.statement: Quianda is especially important to fishermen and sailors.
claims.statement_id: Quianda sangat penting bagi nelayan dan pelaut.
claims.quote: A Quianda é especialmente importante aos pescadores e marinheiros.

claims.statement: The Quianda festival is held in Luanda one week before the Procession of Nossa Senhora do Cabo.
claims.statement_id: Pesta Quianda diadakan di Luanda seminggu sebelum prosesi Nossa Senhora do Cabo.
claims.quote: A festa da Quianda é realizada em Luanda uma semana antes da Procissão de Nossa Senhora do Cabo, que tem forte relação sincrética.

claims.statement: Zaebos is a demon or spirit in the Dictionnaire Infernal described as Grand Count mounted on a crocodile.
claims.statement_id: Zaebos adalah iblis dalam Dictionnaire Infernal yang bergelar Grand Count dan berwujud prajurit tampan penunggang buaya.
claims.quote: Zaebos is a demon or spirit mentioned in the Dictionnaire Infernal. It is described as the Grand Count of the infernal realms and is said to appear in the form of a handsome soldier mounted on a crocodile.

claims.statement: Zaebos is a demon or spirit mentioned in the Dictionnaire Infernal.
claims.statement_id: Zaebos adalah iblis atau roh yang dicantumkan dalam Dictionnaire Infernal.
claims.quote: Zaebos is a demon or spirit mentioned in the Dictionnaire Infernal.

claims.statement: It is described as appearing in the form of a handsome soldier mounted on a crocodile.
claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan berwujud prajurit tampan yang menunggangi buaya.
claims.quote: It is described as the Grand Count of the infernal realms and is said to appear in the form of a handsome soldier mounted on a crocodile.

claims.statement: Zaebos is a demon or spirit in the Dictionnaire Infernal.
claims.statement_id: Zaebos adalah iblis atau roh dalam Dictionnaire Infernal.
claims.quote: Zaebos é um demônio ou espírito no Dictionnaire Infernal.

claims.statement: Zaebos is described as an infernal figure appearing in the form of a handsome soldier mounted on a caiman.
claims.statement_id: Zaebos digambarkan sebagai penguasa neraka yang berwujud prajurit rupawan penunggang aligator.
claims.quote: Zaebos é descrito como o Grande Contador dos reinos infernais e aparece na forma de um belo soldado montado em um jacaré.

claims.statement: He appears in the form of a handsome soldier mounted on a caiman.
claims.statement_id: Entitas ini muncul dalam wujud prajurit elok penunggang buaya.
claims.quote: aparece na forma de um belo soldado montado em um jacaré.

claims.statement: Merfolk, Mercreatures, Mermen or Merpeople are legendary water-dwelling, human-like beings.
claims.statement_id: Merfolk atau Merpeople adalah makhluk mirip manusia legendaris yang mendiami perairan.
claims.quote: Merfolk, Mercreatures, Mermen or Merpeople are legendary water-dwelling, human-like beings.

claims.statement: In English, female merfolk are called mermaids appearing half-woman and half-fish; male merfolk are called mermen.
claims.statement_id: Merfolk perempuan disebut mermaids yang berwujud setengah wanita setengah ikan, sedangkan laki-laki disebut mermen.
claims.quote: In English, female merfolk are called mermaids, although in a strict sense, mermaids are confined to beings who are half-woman and half-fish in appearance; male merfolk are called mermen.

claims.statement: Chinese rényú stands for merfolk, referring to human-fish in rivers or lakes.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bahasa Tionghoa rényú berarti manusia-ikan yang mendiami sungai atau danau.
claims.quote: Chinese rényú (人魚) stands for "merfolk", but in ancient geographical or natural historical tracts, the term referred to "human-fish" or "man-fish" purported to inhabit rivers or lakes in certain parts of China.

claims.statement: The Japanese analogue ningyo translates to human-fish recorded from medieval times into the Edo Period.
claims.statement_id: Ningyo dalam bahasa Jepang berarti manusia-ikan yang tercatat dari abad pertengahan hingga Edo Period.
claims.quote: The Japanese analogue ningyo (人魚) likewise translates to "human-fish" while, at the same time, having also applied to various human-like fish recorded in writings from medieval times into the Edo Period.

claims.statement: Merfolk in the Philippines are known collectively as Taga-Dagat or Bantay Tubig.
claims.statement_id: Merfolk di Filipina dikenal sebagai Taga-Dagat atau Bantay Tubig.
claims.quote: Ang mga merfolk, na kilala bilang kolektibong Taga-Dagat o minsan ay Bantay Tubig, ay mga nilalang-tubig sa mitolohiyang Pilipino.

claims.statement: The most famous persona of merfolk is the Sirena with a human female upper body and fish tail.
claims.statement_id: Wujud merfolk paling terkenal adalah Sirena yang bertubuh perempuan di bagian atas dan berekor ikan.
claims.quote: Ang pinakakilalang katauhan ng merfolk ay ang Sirena, isang nilalang na kahawig ng sirena na may pang-itaas na bahagi ng katawan ng babaeng tao at buntot ng isda.

claims.statement: Sireno is the male counterpart of Sirena.
claims.statement_id: Sireno adalah padanan laki-laki dari Sirena.
claims.quote: Ang Sireno ang lalaking katumbas ng Sirena, bagama’t hindi ito gaanong lumalabas sa mga kuwento.

claims.statement: A zitiron, or sea knight, is a mythological creature that has an upper body in the form of an armed knight, fused with the tail of a fish.
claims.statement_id: Zitiron atau sea knight adalah makhluk mitologi berbadan atas kesatria bersenjata dan berekor ikan.
claims.quote: A zitiron, or sea knight, is a mythological creature that has an upper body in the form of an armed knight, fused with the tail of a fish.

claims.statement: A zitiron is a medieval mythological marine creature, half-fish and half-armed knight.
claims.statement_id: Zitiron adalah makhluk mitologi laut abad pertengahan setengah ikan setengah kesatria bersenjata.
claims.quote: Un zitiron ou zytiron est une créature mythologique marine du Moyen Âge, un être hybride, mi-poisson, mi-chevalier en armes.

claims.statement: The zitiron appears in De natura rerum by Thomas de Cantimpré, written around 1240.
claims.statement_id: Zitiron muncul dalam De natura rerum karya Thomas de Cantimpré sekitar 1240.
claims.quote: Le zitiron apparaît dans le chapitre VI du De natura rerum de Thomas de Cantimpré, rédigé vers 1240

claims.statement: It was included in Jacob van Maerlant's Der Naturen Bloeme in 1350.
claims.statement_id: Ia termuat dalam puisi Der Naturen Bloeme karya Jacob van Maerlant pada 1350.
claims.quote: il est repris dans le poème en néerlandais de Jacob van Maerlant, Der Naturen Bloeme en 1350

claims.statement: It is also found in the Hortus sanitatis, printed in 1491.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini juga ditemukan dalam Hortus sanitatis yang dicetak pada 1491.
claims.quote: On le trouve également dans la partie consacrée aux poissons (« De piscibus ») du Hortus sanitatis (Jardin de santé), imprimé pour la première fois à Mayence en 1491

claims.statement: It has rough and hard skin, bears a shield, and has thick arms with only two fingers.
claims.statement_id: Kulitnya keras dan kasar, membawa perisai, dan lengannya tebal dengan dua jari.
claims.quote: Il a la peau rugueuse et dure ; il porte un bouclier. Ses bras sont épais et il n'a que deux doigts.

claims.statement: It cannot be killed with arrows, but only with hammers, protecting itself with its shield.
claims.statement_id: Ia tidak dapat dibunuh dengan panah melainkan hanya dengan palu, dan melindungi diri dengan perisainya.
claims.quote: Il ne peut être tué avec des flèches, mais seulement avec des marteaux et il se protège avec son bouclier et en donnant des coups avec ses bras.

claims.statement: Baak, Bak or Ghorabak is a shapeshifting creature that frequently appears in folktales in Assam.
claims.statement_id: Baak, Bak atau Ghorabak adalah makhluk pengubah wujud yang sering muncul dalam cerita rakyat Assam.
claims.quote: Baak, Bak or Ghorabak (Assamese: বাঁক, ঘোঁৰাবাঁক; IPA: ['bak]) is a shapeshifting creature that frequently appears in folktales in Assam.

claims.statement: The baak is believed to live near water bodies and is usually malevolent in nature, troubling fishermen.
claims.statement_id: Baak dipercaya hidup di dekat perairan, menyukai ikan, dan mengganggu nelayan.
claims.quote: The baak is believed to live near water bodies and is usually malevolent in nature, troubling fishermen among others. The baak is fond of fish.

claims.statement: Baak can be murderous, drowning its victim and assuming the form of its victim after death.
claims.statement_id: Baak dapat menenggelamkan korban dan mengambil alih rupa korban setelah kematiannya.
claims.quote: Baak can be murderous, drowning its victim to death. It often assumes the form of its victim after death or possesses the victim.

claims.statement: Carrying a torn fishing net can help avoid baaks, as they are said to be afraid of it.
claims.statement_id: Membawa jaring ikan yang sobek dapat menghindarkan dari baak karena mereka takut padanya.
claims.quote: Carrying a torn fishing net can help avoid baaks, as they are said to be afraid of it.

claims.statement: Baak inhabits reservoirs in Assamese folklore and troubles fishermen.
claims.statement_id: Baak mendiami perairan dalam cerita rakyat Assam dan mengganggu para nelayan.
claims.quote: बाक या घुँराबाक् (असमिया : বাঁক, IPA: ['bak]) असम के लोकगाथाओं मे पाने जाने वाला एक काल्पनिक प्राणी हैं।। माना जाता हैं कि बाक जलाशयों मे वास करते हैं, और लोगो को, विशेषतः मछवारो को तंग करते हैं।

claims.statement: Baak can be fatal, drowning victims and assuming the form of the prey.
claims.statement_id: Baak dapat mematikan dan menenggelamkan korbannya lalu mengambil rupa mangsanya.
claims.quote: बाक जानलेवा हो सकते है,  और अपने शिकार को अकसर डुबो कर मार डालते हैं। यह अक्सर मृत्यु के बाद अपने शिकार का रूप धारण कर लेते है या पीड़ित को अपने कब्जे में ले लेते है।

claims.statement: Carrying a torn fishing net helps avoid baak as they fear it.
claims.statement_id: Membawa jaring ikan robek dapat membantu terhindar dari baak karena mereka takut padanya.
claims.quote: फटे हुए मछली पकड़ने के जाल को ले जाने से बाक से बचने में मदद मिल सकती है, क्योंकि कहा जाता है कि वे इससे डरते हैं।

claims.statement: Saint Romanus delivered the country around Rouen from a monster called Gargouille or Goji.
claims.statement_id: Saint Romain menyelamatkan negeri di sekitar Rouen dari seekor monster bernama Gargouille atau Goji.
claims.quote: relates how he delivered the country around Rouen from a monster called Gargouille or Goji.

claims.statement: La Gargouille is said to have been a dragon with bat-like wings, a long neck, and fire breath.
claims.statement_id: La Gargouille digambarkan sebagai naga bersayap kelelawar, berleher panjang, dan mampu menyemburkan api.
claims.quote: La Gargouille is said to have been a standard dragon of Western-European origin, with bat-like wings, a long neck, and the ability to breathe fire.

claims.statement: Saint Romanus subdued the creature with a crucifix or captured it with the help of a condemned man.
claims.statement_id: Saint Romanus menundukkan makhluk itu dengan salib atau menangkapnya dengan bantuan seorang terpidana mati.
claims.quote: Multiple versions of the story are given, either that St. Romanus subdued the creature with a crucifix, or he captured the creature with the help of the only volunteer, a condemned man.

claims.statement: The monster was burned in Rouen, but its head and neck resisted burning and were mounted upon cathedral walls.
claims.statement_id: Monster itu dibakar di Rouen namun kepala dan lehernya tidak mempan terbakar sehingga dipasang di dinding katedral.
claims.quote: In each, the monster is led back to Rouen and burned, but its head and neck would not burn due to being tempered by its own fire breath, so the head was mounted upon the cathedral walls to serve as a prophylactic against evil spirits.

claims.statement: The dragon or gargouille was a giant serpent haunting the marshes on the left bank of the Seine.
claims.statement_id: Gargouille adalah naga atau ular raksasa di rawa-rawa tepi kiri Seine yang memangsa manusia dan hewan ternak.
claims.quote: Le dragon, appelé aussi la gargouille : sur la rive gauche de la Seine, s'étalaient des marécages, où sévissait un énorme serpent qui « dévouroit et détruisoit les genz et bestes du païs ».

claims.statement: Saint Romain made the sign of the cross, leashed the beast with his stole, and had the convict lead it into town to be burned.
claims.statement_id: Saint Romain membuat tanda salib, menalikan stolanya, dan menyuruh terpidana mati menuntunnya ke kota untuk dibakar.
claims.quote: Saint Romain traça un signe de croix sur lui, la bête se coucha à ses pieds, il prit son étole comme licou, et le condamné à mort la ramena ainsi tenue en laisse dans la ville, où elle fut brûlée (ou jetée dans la Seine, selon les auteurs).

claims.statement: This legend originated the bishop's privilege to pardon a condemned man each year during the procession.
claims.statement_id: Legenda ini menjadi asal-usul hak uskup untuk mengampuni satu terpidana mati setiap tahun saat prosesi.
claims.quote: Cette dernière légende est à l'origine du privilège des évêques de gracier un condamné à mort tous les ans, en lui faisant porter la fierte (la châsse) contenant les reliques du saint lors d'une procession ; ce privilège perdura jusqu'en 1790.

claims.statement: The Sea Swine (a.k.a. Porcus Marinus) was the name given to sea-dwelling or mythological creatures.
claims.statement_id: Sea Swine atau Porcus Marinus adalah nama bagi berbagai makhluk laut atau mitologis sepanjang sejarah.
claims.quote: The Sea Swine (a.k.a. Porcus Marinus) was the name given to a variety of sea-dwelling or mythological creatures throughout history.

claims.statement: The earliest mention of a sea swine can be traced to ancient Greece.
claims.statement_id: Sebutan babi laut paling awal dapat ditelusuri ke Yunani kuno.
claims.quote: The earliest mention of a 'sea swine' can be traced to ancient Greece.

claims.statement: The creatures appeared in the Carta marina as fantastical beasts with four dragon's feet and a single eye at the navel.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini muncul dalam Carta marina sebagai monster dengan empat kaki naga dan satu mata di pusar.
claims.quote: The creatures appeared in the Carta marina, and were depicted in accompanying wood carvings, as fantastical beasts with four dragon's feet and a single eye at the navel.

claims.statement: The map placed the creatures as living in the waters south of Iceland.
claims.statement_id: Peta tersebut menempatkan makhluk ini hidup di perairan selatan Islandia.
claims.quote: The map placed the creatures as living in the waters south of Iceland.

claims.statement: The animals were described as headed like a Hog, toothed, and tusked like a Boar.
claims.statement_id: Hewan tersebut digambarkan berkepala babi serta bertaring seperti babi liar.
claims.quote: The animals were described as "headed like a Hog, toothed, and tusked like a Boar".

claims.statement: The Sea Hogs were reported as travelling in packs with hundreds of individuals.
claims.statement_id: Sea Hogs dilaporkan berenang dalam kelompok yang terdiri dari ratusan individu.
claims.quote: The Sea Hogs were reported as travelling in packs with hundreds of individuals.

claims.statement: Naturalist John Ray was explicit in stating that the sea swine and porpoise were one and the same.
claims.statement_id: Naturalis John Ray menyatakan bahwa babi laut dan porpoise adalah makhluk yang sama.
claims.quote: However, contemporary naturalist John Ray was explicit in stating that the sea swine and porpoise were one and the same.

claims.statement: Xeglun is the celestial elk in Tungusic mythology.
claims.statement_id: Xeglun adalah rusa besar langit dalam mitologi Tungusic.
claims.quote: Xeglun is the celestial elk in Tungusic mythology.

claims.statement: It was Mangi (Xargi)'s pursuit of this creature that was said to have created the Milky Way.
claims.statement_id: Pengejaran Mangi (Xargi) terhadap makhluk ini konon menciptakan Bima Sakti.
claims.quote: It was Mangi (Xargi)'s pursuit of this creature that was said to have created the Milky Way.

claims.statement: Xeglun is the celestial elk of Tungusic mythology.
claims.statement_id: Xeglun merupakan rusa besar langit dari mitologi Toungouse.
claims.quote: Xeglun est l'élan céleste de la mythologie Toungouse.

claims.statement: The Milky Way was believed created through the pursuit of Xeglun by Xargi.
claims.statement_id: Bima Sakti dipercaya tercipta akibat pengejaran Xeglun oleh Xargi.
claims.quote: La Voie lactée aurait été créée par la poursuite de Xeglun par Xargi (en).

claims.statement: Xeglun was the celestial elk referenced in regional mythological accounts.
claims.statement_id: Xeglun merupakan rusa besar surgawi dalam catatan mitologi kawasan Asia.
claims.quote: Xeglun era o alce celestial na mitologia chinesa.

claims.statement: Belief holds that the cause of the Milky Way was Mangi's pursuit of this creature.
claims.statement_id: Diyakini bahwa penyebab terciptanya Via Lactea adalah perburuan Mangi terhadap makhluk ini.
claims.quote: Acredita-se que a causa da criação da Via Láctea foi a perseguição de Mangi a esta criatura.

claims.statement: Roesschaert was a tormenting spirit targeting the people of Blankenberge and especially fishermen.
claims.statement_id: Roesschaert adalah roh pengganggu yang mengincar penduduk Blankenberge dan terutama para nelayan.
claims.quote: Roesschaert was een kwelgêest die ’t gemunt ad ip de Blanknbergenoars en surtout ip de visschers.

claims.statement: The Blankenberge legend has many similarities with Lange Wapper of the Scheldt who plagued humans.
claims.statement_id: Legenda Blankenberge memiliki banyak kemiripan dengan Lange Wapper dari Schelde yang suka mengganggu manusia.
claims.quote: De Blanknbergsche sage vertôont vele  gelykenisse met de Antwerpsche Lange Wapper die in de Schelde verblêef,  ounder verschillnde gedoantes verschêen en die ’t gêestig vound van menschn te kwelln en zelfs loate wandeloars te wurgn.

claims.statement: The next day at the site of the cottage there walked a little dog with bells around its neck.
claims.statement_id: Keesokan harinya di lokasi reruntuhan pondok terlihat seekor anjing kecil dengan bel di lehernya.
claims.quote: Den volgndn dag giengn ze kykn en ip de plekke woa dat uzetje stound liept er een oundje me belletjes round z’n nekke.

claims.statement: It grew larger and larger and shouted roes, thus receiving the name Roesschaert.
claims.statement_id: Anjing itu tumbuh semakin besar sambil berteriak roes sehingga dinamai Roesschaert.
claims.quote: ’t Wierd alsan moa grotter en grotter en ’t riep: roes, roes, roes. En azo krêeg ’t de noame “Roesschaert”.

claims.statement: The hound changed into a cat, a donkey, a child, a walking barrel, and often into a fisherman.
claims.statement_id: Ia mengubah wujud menjadi kucing, keledai, anak-anak, tong berjalan, atau nelayan.
claims.quote: Den ound veranderde e ki in een katte, ton in een ezel, een kind, een vuuloop, een wandelnde tunne… en dikwyls ook in een visscher.

claims.statement: The creature could not utter the name God, replacing it with another expression.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk itu tidak dapat mengucapkan nama Tuhan, menggantinya dengan sebutan lain.
claims.quote: D’r was moar êen twadde: je kost de noame “God“ nie uutspreekn. In plekke van “in Godsnoame”  zeit’n alsan “in potsnoame”.

claims.statement: To be freed from the tormenting spirit, it was necessary to change one's name during a baptismal ceremony.
claims.statement_id: Untuk terbebas dari roh pengganggu itu, seseorang harus mengganti namanya melalui upacara pembaptisan khusus.
claims.quote: Vo van de kwelgêest bevryd te geroakn was ’t absoluut nôodzoakelik van noame te verandern. Da gebeurde binst een eigenoardige “doopplechtigeid”.

claims.statement: Terrible Monster is a creature that allegedly attacked Jerusalem in the early 18th century.
claims.statement_id: Terrible Monster adalah makhluk yang konon menyerang Jerusalem pada awal abad ke-18.
claims.quote: Terrible Monster is a creature that allegedly attacked Jerusalem in the early 18th century.

claims.statement: According to local lore, it was formed of the blood of murder victims and would kill anyone who came near it.
claims.statement_id: Menurut cerita setempat, ia terbentuk dari darah korban pembunuhan dan membunuh siapa pun yang mendekat.
claims.quote: According to local lore, it was formed of the blood of murder victims and would kill anyone who came near it.

claims.statement: The chimerical monster was nearly 50 feet long, with a lion's head, eagle beak and talons, and a scorpion's venomous tail.
claims.statement_id: Monster chimera ini panjangnya hampir 50 kaki dengan kepala singa, paruh dan cakar elang, serta ekor kalajengking berbisa.
claims.quote: The chimerical monster was said to be nearly 50 feet long, with the head of a lion, the beak and talons of an eagle, and the tail of a scorpion, with which venom was its principal weapon, much like a manticore.

claims.statement: It was also completely covered with chain mail that appeared to be made from mother of pearl.
claims.statement_id: Tubuhnya sepenuhnya terbungkus baju zirah rantai yang tampak terbuat dari kulit mutiara.
claims.quote: It was also completely covered with chain mail that appeared to be made from mother of pearl.

claims.statement: Its only weak point proved to be having a spear flung down its throat.
claims.statement_id: Satu-satunya titik lemahnya terbukti adalah dilempari tombak ke dalam tenggorokannya.
claims.quote: Its only weak point proved to be, not unlike The Chimera, having a spear flung down its throat.

claims.statement: It is known by no other name, aside from the translation.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini tidak dikenal dengan nama lain selain dari terjemahan tersebut.
claims.quote: It is known by no other name, aside from the translation.
